newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INCE SET TO JOIN LIVERPOOL NEXT WEEK, AGENCY SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INCE SET TO JOIN LIVERPOOL NEXT WEEK, AGENCY SAYS.

text.p: Internazionale's England international Paul Ince will almost certainly join Liverpool next week for around 14 billion lire ($8.2 million), Italian news agency ANSA reported on Saturday.
It said officials from the English premier league side would arrive in Milan on Monday to offer Ince a three-year contract.
Ince has said he will leave Inter before the start of next season and has been linked to several English sides, including Arsenal, Blackburn and Liverpool.
Late on Friday, Inter announced they had signed Brazilian midfielder Ze Elias -- a natural replacement for Ince -- from German club Bayer Leverkusen.
